word.definition: Spindrift refers to spray blown from waves during a gale or to fine wind-borne snow or sand.

sports_fact.text: Boxing's first million-dollar gate was Dempsey-Carpentier in 1921, in a wooden stadium built just for the fight — and torn down right after.

market.headline: Wall Street Thinks It Knows How Tech Giants Will Make AI Pay
market.summary: Investors are coming around to the idea that Big Tech spending on AI can make sense—as long as there is a cloud-computing business involved.

quote.text: Says a writer whom few know, "Forty years after a battle it is easy for a non-combatant to reason about how it ought to have been fought. It is another thing personally and under fire to direct the fighting while involved in the obscuring smoke of it. Much so with respect to other emergencies involving considerations both practical and moral, and when it is imperative promptly to act."
quote.author: Herman Melville

history.text: The first synod of Arles is opened by bishop Marinus of Arles.
